status: Added after inspecting primary and forced-split diagnostics; publish as sensitivity only.
reason: The forced two-state variant improves P13 gap-short. Give cheap baselines an equivalent fixed-capacity sensitivity rather than allowing only the proposed method to override training CV complexity choice.

variants.cheap_ridge: Full-feature quadratic ridge; alpha selected by training-configuration CV
